title: Angry Woman Arrested For Burning Down Boyfriend's House
description:
Start a completely FREE trial with our sponsor Aura and protect yourself from getting scammed: https://www.aura.com/insider 

On October 13th, 2022, officers were dispatched to a residence in reference to a verbal altercation between the homeowner and his live-in girlfriend. Dispatch advised that the female had been drinking and was throwing things in the house. Scared, the male had walked out of the house. The female was charged with assault and resisting arrest. No information is available on whether or not she was charged with setting the fire.
